verdict.rationale: CLI docs show conversations can be paused (Esc) and resumed, and the SDK's ask_agent guide notes that questions 'don't interrupt the main conversation flow - they're processed separately,' while conversation-goals describes stop/resume controls for an ongoing agent objective — together these support mid-session steering without a full restart. However, no evidence explicitly confirms arbitrary follow-up instructions are merged into an in-progress task rather than merely queued/paused. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injecting new steering instructions mid-execution and independent/hands-on confirmation that the agent adapts its plan accordingly.
